verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no documented programmatic way to create or update entries. The official CLI is described as an export and backup utility only. No OpenAPI or other API surface was found, and the only documented deep link (enteauth://search) handles search. Adding entries is documented solely through the in-app UI: QR scan, manual secret entry, and importing plaintext or other-provider files by hand. None of these is an agent-drivable surface for seeding or updating vault entries.
